title: Dimension of a local ring of a scheme by chains of generalizations
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $x\in X$. Call a *chain of generalizations of $x$ of length $n$* a sequence of points $x=x_0,x_1,\dots,x_n$ of $X$ with $x_{i-1}\in\overline{\{x_i\}}$ and $x_{i-1}\neq x_i$ for $1\le i\le n$. Then the Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is
$$\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}=\sup\{n:\ \text{there is a chain of generalizations of }x\text{ of length }n\}\in\{0,1,2,\ldots,\infty\}.$$
Equivalently, $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is the codimension of the irreducible closed subset $\overline{\{x\}}$ in $X$: the supremum of the lengths $n$ of chains $\overline{\{x\}}=Z_0\subsetneq Z_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq Z_n$ of irreducible closed subsets of $X$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] (the two suprema agree because $y\mapsto\overline{\{y\}}$ is an inclusion-preserving bijection from points to irreducible closed subsets [lem-sc-scheme-sober]).
